title: Rapid triage and customer-facing fallback shim for correlated 5xx/timeouts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Several large customers reported simultaneous 5xx spikes and streaming timeouts in the hosted inference API during a regional tenant migration. Root analysis points to a multi-factor amplification: edge proxy connection churn, uncontrolled client retries, and bursty KV cache evictions causing downstream runtime slowpaths. This ticket scopes a rapid, low-risk mitigation (fallback shim + admission controls) that reduces customer-visible errors while we stabilize the runtime and KV compaction flow.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant emergency fallback can be toggled from Console and applies within 30s
Fallback reduces per-request fanout and routes to a lightweight model variant without invalidating client contracts
Client-visible 5xx rate for impacted tenants drops by >=70% in the first 10 minutes after activation
No new P0 regressions introduced (latency SLOs verified on canary traffic)
steps_taken: 2025-02-10 09:15 - Pager call with on-call and SEs; identified surge correlated with KV compaction jobs
2025-02-10 10:30 - Temporarily increased edge proxy connection pool and added per-tenant leaky bucket (hotpatch) to limit fanout
2025-02-11 02:00 - Deployed telemetry anchors for idempotency tokens and per-request fanout count to surface amplification sources
2025-02-12 16:40 - Reproduced retry amplification in staging using synthetic tenant that replays customer workload patterns
2025-02-14 11:05 - Implemented and QA'd fallback shim that short-circuits to smaller model and disables KV prefetch for toggled tenants
proposed_fix: Ship a togglable 'emergency fallback shim' that: 1) caps proxy fanout per request, 2) routes to validated lightweight model variants (same API surface), 3) disables non-essential KV cache prefetch and continuous batching for affected tenants, and 4) applies a retry-hysteresis header to SDK flows to prevent immediate client amplification.
rollback_plan: Console toggle to revert tenant to normal routing. Edge proxy config rollback (previous connection limits) scripted as a single-step infra rollback. If fallback causes customer regressions, disable per-tenant shim and fail open to existing routing within 60s.
logs_summary: Edge proxy showed elevated SYN_RETRIES and numerous half-closed connections. Runtime hosts logged increased KV cache eviction rates and frequent slowpath calls (~15x normal). Traces show retry chains with identical idempotency tokens caused by client-side unbounded retries after short timeouts.
